verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's Router explicitly supports load-balancing across multiple deployments/keys (e.g., multiple Azure/OpenAI keys) and virtual keys carry per-key rpm_limit fields, directly enabling spreading traffic across provider keys to smooth rate limits, with retries/fallbacks for failures. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a request queuing/throttling mechanism beyond rpm_limit and load balancing, and independent hands-on confirmation that this smooths real provider rate-limit errors under load.
